result: Phase 3 proceeds only with the guards in the Phase 2 report

decision: Stream Demucs windows through the app's isolation pipeline instead of capping track length
reason: A prototype of apply_model's windows (pcm/demucs-window.ts) and the HTDemucs STFT and iSTFT (inference/demucs-segment.ts) reproduces the numpy reference: first-window feeds at 144.6 to 145.9 dB, the same as the vendored path, and full-length vocals and drums + bass + other within the ORT-Web gap scenario-01 documents
result: Memory is one window of history and accumulators, independent of length; no length cap

decision: Make Demucs the only isolation engine and remove SCNet
reason: User scope change after Phase 2; Demucs WebGPU was 3.7 to 4 times faster and two engines doubled model, license and test surface
result: SCNet code, model, licenses and SCNet-only drivers deleted; its evidence stays in docs/sprint-evidence

decision: Run Demucs on single-thread WASM when no hardware WebGPU adapter exists
reason: With one engine, CPU is the only way to keep isolation working there; it is slower than real time (81 s per 60 s on an M5) and the editor says so
result: Adapter check still rejects missing, fallback and SwiftShader adapters before choosing WebGPU

decision: Label GPU only after a window issues GPU compute dispatches
reason: Phase 2 saw ORT run a "webgpu" session entirely on CPU when no adapter existed; the worker counts dispatchWorkgroups per window and the runner reports that case as CPU and records the backend as wasm
result: Badge and stats come from evidence, not the requested provider

decision: Keep one worker and one ORT session per job, with one sticky WASM retry after a GPU failure
reason: Phase 2 measured 1.2 s session setup per creation; a job reuses it for every window. A GPU session, run failure or stall retries that window on WASM and stays on WASM, matching the old engine's fallback semantics
result: Cancel terminates the worker; model, session and window each have deadlines, and download progress keeps a slow 85 MB download alive

decision: Restore each stem with the track mean, as upstream Demucs does
reason: The reference adds the mean back to every stem, so music = drums + bass + other carries three times the mean; the mean is the mix's DC offset and usually negligible

decision: Accept and drop a stray isolation `engine` key instead of rejecting the recipe
reason: The user asked that recipes with or without an engine field keep parsing, without adding the field to the schema; the isolation step schema is non-strict for that one step
